name: comfyui-lora-tag-hash-metadata
description: ComfyUI node that converts <lora:name:weight> tags into Civitai-friendly Name:HASH:Weight metadata strings.

scripts.setup:e2e: playwright install --with-deps chromium && node scripts/setup-e2e-comfy.mjs && node scripts/setup-e2e-packs.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm setup:e2e && playwright test
scripts.e2e:serve: pnpm build && pnpm setup:e2e && node scripts/e2e-serve.mjs
